description: EGAT Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand is a data repository run by Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand. The state generator publishes power-plant information, generation and system-demand figures and the national power development plan documents, with a real-time system-load display. Coverage: Thailand. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as html, pdf; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("EGAT - Landing Page - การไฟฟ้าฝ่ายผลิตแห่งประเทศไทย") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support electricity supply and demand studies of Thailand. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
